_readme: One list for every guard of player-facing coverage (MOD-963 guide book and wiki, MOD-935 blueprints).
Each row: an item id the player can hold, the surfaces it is deliberately left off (book, wiki, blueprint) and why.
A row with no reason, an unknown surface, an id the player cannot hold, or a surface where the item is covered after all fails the guard that reads that surface.

assembly_blueprint.reason: MOD-963, owner decision 2026-11-13: the mechanic is not yet open to the player, so it has no OKF spec and no book or wiki page yet. Remove the row when its spec is written.

creative_energy_source.reason: MOD-518: a creative-only tool that survival cannot obtain; the book is a survival walkthrough, while the wiki keeps the page as a reference (gen_guide_book.BOOK_EXCLUDE).

high_altitude_wind_mill.reason: A hidden evolution of the wind mill (T2): the book does not announce it before the player meets it; the wiki keeps the page (gen_guide_book.BOOK_EXCLUDE).
